name: fuzzing
title: Fuzzing and sanitizers

conditions.targets: redaction, transcript extraction, wiki citations, technote parsing, usage statistics
conditions.each check: 20 s of libFuzzer per target under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, plus the whole test suite under both

summary: Redaction must never crash, must change nothing when run twice, and must leave no secret that a rule recognizes. Every input that ever broke one of these is kept as a seed and replayed on each check.

metrics.label: Bugs found by fuzzing this week
metrics.note: a token rule matched across a line break, so redacting twice differed from once; fixed

baseline: three properties that must always hold for redaction
meaning: Fuzzing found a real bug this week, in a rule that could match across a line break. It did not let a secret through. The failing input is now replayed on every check.
